# opening_router_v4

Named wrapper of guarded_hires_v3. Parent v3 keeps its public-worker opening
selector, Thomas branch, source55 course, Mao85 opening markets and local V30
day rebuilds. Seven additional rebuilt days run only when their required
physical starting state matches. The complete parent handles other days.
The guard does not certify future cash or prices. No hidden state, seed or
future shops enter the agent. Exact component lineage is in IMPORT.json.

Fresh 1024-game comparisons: 860 wins versus v3, 958 versus v2, all versus
Thomas, both tested teammate families and three older counters; 958 Mao85,
675 Mao89, 14 Junghoon78. A second fresh batch gives 401 Binghua116, 503
John128 and 570 John131, each slightly better than v3 on the same scenarios.
Native RNG audits support the v3 improvement. These results belong to the
identical underlying candidate; all 1024 wrapper game records match. Generic four-thread and debug typed
one-thread checks match in 16 games; PASS and self-play pass.

Thirty-two paired healthy profiles preserve output, sale volumes, daily
biology and land. Mean hire savings are $175.38; cash improves $173.44 after
small trading/input differences. Junghoon and Binghua remain weaknesses.
